topic: Sun's Movement, Shadows, and Importance to Living Things
key_concepts: The Sun rotates on its axis once every 27 days
Galileo Galilei discovered the Sun's rotation by observing sunspots
The Sun's equator rotates faster than its polar regions
The apparent movement of the Sun across the sky is caused by Earth's rotation
Earth's rotation causes the day-night cycle
Shadows form when an object blocks sunlight
Shadow length and direction change throughout the day
Morning shadows are long and point west, noon shadows are very short, and afternoon shadow
The Sun provides gravitational force that keeps heavenly bodies in orbit
The Sun provides light energy for photosynthesis in plants
The Sun is a source of renewable solar energy
Sunlight helps the human body manufacture vitamin D
